required_tuples.assertion: delete-author-unlinks-books: DELETE /api/authors/:id answers 200, deletes the author and its book links but keeps the books, removes the author from their metadata.json, and sends author_removed with the full author JSON to every client.
required_tuples.rationale: DELETE /api/authors/:id answers 200, deletes the author and its book links but keeps the books, removes the author from their metadata.json, and sends author_removed with the full author JSON to every client.

required_tuples.assertion: delete-author-twice: Deleting an author that was already deleted answers 404 and sends no event.

required_tuples.rationale: Adding a new author name to a book through PATCH /api/items/:id/media creates the author and sends author_added with the author JSON (no numBooks) to every client, and none for the author already on the book.

required_tuples.rationale: Repeating the same item update, which changes nothing, sends neither author_added nor author_updated.

required_tuples.rationale: An item update refused with 403 (user without update permission) creates no author and sends no author event.

not_applicable.reason: external host: the success path (asin, image, description from the provider) runs only against api.audnex.us (server/providers/Audnexus.js:24); offline, authorisation, 404 for unknown author, request validation and the no-match 404 with no side effects are asserted (match-denied-changes-nothing, match-no-result-is-404, match-no-result-repeat). Provider errors are caught and give null, so the 404 holds offline and online.
external host: state-dependent branches (asin update, image only when none or asin changed, description) need api.audnex.us; the offline-deterministic outcome does not depend on author state.
confirmed: the route has no force mode (server/controllers/AuthorController.js:337-383).

open_findings: route-r134/route-r136/route-r137: the library-access rule (user without access to the author's library gets 404 from the shared middleware, before the permission check, AuthorController.js:428-430) is exercised only for GET, PATCH and DELETE /api/authors/:id; add a restricted-library user case to the denied scenarios of match, image upload and image delete (assert 404 and no change).

route-r132/r133/r136/r137: no positive authorisation case for a non-admin: every success is by root. Add a user with only update (PATCH, POST match, update+upload for POST image) and a user with only delete (DELETE author, DELETE image) who succeeds, so an admin-only or wrong-permission implementation fails (client EditModal.vue offers these by canUpdate/canDelete).

route-r131: GET ?include=items applies the user's restrictions (getFilteredLibraryItems: item tags allow and deny mode, explicit content; libraryItemsBookFilters.js:13-30) and no scenario uses a user with tag or explicit restrictions; add one for each rule showing libraryItems and series are filtered.

route-r131: series items are sorted by naturalSort on the sequence but the scenario only has sequences 1 and 2 (a plain string sort passes); add a series with sequences such as 2, 10 and 1.5 to pin the order.

route-r132: merge matching is exact-name (SQL = on name, same library) and no scenario shows a case-different name is a plain rename, nor that an author of the same name in another library is not merged; add both variants.

socket-outgoing-author-removed: author-removed-by-rescan matches any author_removed with the library id and then only checks that the payload id has no row, so a payload with another already-gone id passes; capture the id of 'Scan Gone' before the second scan and assert the event id equals it (also for the item-delete/item-update sweeps: the payload is {id, libraryId} only, assert no other client-read field is expected).
